name: Jose Luis Piña
office: Lynwood Unified School District, Governing Board Member

items.text: Jose Luis Piña is a candidate for the Lynwood Unified School District Governing Board. His campaign says he served as PTO president at Mark Twain Elementary and president of the District English Learner Advisory Committee. It also says he is a business owner with experience in insurance, tax preparation, real estate, and business management.

sentences.text: Jose Luis Piña is a candidate for the Lynwood Unified School District Governing Board.
His campaign says he served as PTO president at Mark Twain Elementary and president of the District English Learner Advisory Committee.
It also says he is a business owner with experience in insurance, tax preparation, real estate, and business management.

items.text: His campaign priorities include student achievement, safe and supportive schools, fiscal responsibility and transparency, parent and community voice, supporting teachers and school employees, and protecting district programs and services.
